integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1405.5154 lists version 1 on 2014-05-20.
integrity.formula_basis: The Grothendieck-ring relation and symmetric-square Euler formula are read from the full archival source; the cubic Euler characteristic is independently derived from the tangent Chern class.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival anchor is submitted in the primary algebraic-geometry category math.AG and concerns cubic hypersurfaces and their Fano varieties.

scientific_limitations: Smooth complex cubic hypersurfaces of dimension at least two.
The theorem concerns the total topological Euler characteristic of the Fano variety of lines.
Singular cubic hypersurfaces require correction terms and are outside scope.
An unindexed source could contain the same short two-adic refinement.
title: Exact dyadic valuation of Euler characteristics of Fano varieties of lines on cubic hypersurfaces
